title: Reachable multiplication configurations
statement: For a Boolean-list input $x$, define the reachable multiplication configurations to be the configurations reachable from the allowed initial configurations for $x$ under the multiplication program, using its two oracle deciders and restricting configurations to those satisfying the good-configuration condition.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the reachability relation or initial-configuration convention, so the exact meaning of this abbreviation is uncertain.
